mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the drainage route was most worthwhile: it showed a complete path from fluid around cells back to a vein, and explained why that matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger lymph vessels to the vein felt a little like a predictable assembly step, although the valve panels helped explain flow.

surprise.text: I didn't expect excess fluid around cells to have a separate vessel route back to the blood; the result also explained that it is called lymph once inside those vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and goals gave each connection a purpose, though the last few choices were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the separate systems connect was interesting, especially the fluid-return route, though the final sequence offered little choice.
